content.title: How Stephen Miller Schemed His Way to the Top
content.caption: The architect of Trump's brutal crackdown on immigration and dissent was appointed as his next chief of staff.

slides.heading: Stephen Miller's Appointment
slides.text: Stephen Miller, one of Trump's most powerful aides, was appointed as the next chief of staff of the White House.

slides.heading: Miller's Background
slides.text: Miller has been with Trump since his first campaign and stood by him through his political exile in 2021.
slides.image_search_query: Stephen Miller, Trump, political exile United States

slides.heading: Miller's Role
slides.text: Miller orchestrated the most polarizing policies of Trump's second term, including a brutal crackdown on immigration.
slides.image_search_query: Stephen Miller, Trump, immigration United States

slides.heading: Impact on Trump's Administration
slides.text: Trump settled on Miller, likely due to his zeal in defending the president and his deep loyalty.
